rules.p95: Practical representative p95 and correctness; do not chase approximately3percent marginal gains.
rules.regressionTolerance: Working measurement rule: investigate repeatable input-queue p95 worsening exceeding max(2ms,10percent) under matched load. Every hang/data-loss/authorization/ownership regression is material regardless of this timing rule. This is a test decision rule, not a universal product SLO.
rules.repeatPolicy: Focused diagnostic before full replay; repeat only after a concrete correction, new failure or unexplained variance.
rules.evidenceReuse: Reuse only when relevant source/dependency/environment/workload inputs match; historical evidence is not final-tree sign-off.
rules.exceptions: Disclose inaccessible hardware GPU/VRAM/private-memory and protected/oversize cases. Physical-device or other required missing qualification is BLOCKED/UNTESTED, never PASS.
rules.folderPolicy: Private mocked fixture; never native folder picker.
rules.stateProtection: No commit/push/publish/installed-app replacement; root owns serial native apps/builds; preserve user sessions and existing dirty worktree.
rules.inspectorBudget: One diagnostic and one correction-validation consumed. Focused control passed; this lane is finished. No new round label, rare event hunting or unchanged catalog replay may reset it. Full required functional matrix remains separate.
rules.observerVersusProduct: Keep run FAIL when observer/RPC prevents evidence; mark unproved gate UNTESTED/inconclusive. Product regression requires exact supported behavior/custody/canonical violation. Never infer owner from cleanup.
rules.branchExercise: Do not launch extra broad rounds solely for rare metadata or100percent observer branch coverage; retain proof limits and reconcile any specifically required proof with original goal.
rules.affectedResidualQualification: R104 verified originalR93 stopping rule: concrete changed failed input or material source fix can justify a declared bounded affected qualification after discriminating preflight. This does not reset any old budget, reopen unchanged broad runner, imply rare100percent branch coverage, or waive missing evidence.
